### Bug Scenario Description and Root Cause

The image shows a dialog box on Alibaba.com with a date picker input field. The placeholder text in the input field is in Chinese, while the rest of the dialog is in English. The issue reported is that the `popupContainer` configuration in `ConfigProvider` is not affecting the `Dialog` component, leading to layout issues as shown in the image.

The root cause is likely that the `Dialog` component is not correctly utilizing the `popupContainer` configuration from `ConfigProvider`, which should dictate where the dialog is rendered in the DOM. This misconfiguration can lead to the dialog being rendered in an unintended location, causing layout problems.

### Bug Location and Analysis

The relevant code snippets are from `src/dialog/dialog.jsx` and `src/config-provider/config.jsx`. The issue seems to be in how the `Dialog` component handles the `popupContainer` property. In `dialog.jsx`, the `container` property of the `Overlay` component is set to `this.props.popupContainer || overlayProps.container`, which might not be correctly receiving the `popupContainer` from `ConfigProvider`.
